items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: At Lovejoy's? Yeah, at Lovejoy's, to see if he was on that night.

ctx.x: Yeah, at Lovejoy's, to see if he was on that night. Because some nights, he was amazing! We'd go by there and, man, we'd come back with our mouth wide open, going "What the hell happened?" It was out of sight.
Did Erroll and Art ever play??
